stages.choice_rule: Four choices. Exactly one is the correct spelling of the short a word the stem clues. The other three misspell that same word only: a wrong vowel, an extra a, a silent e, ay or ai, a dropped letter, or an extra consonant. Never a different real word. Choices are whole words, never a phoneme, a slash sound, or one letter. Spread answer_index from 0 to 3. Media is one lemma, the correct word. Keep the target word and every choice out of the stem.

gold_items.stem: A little sleep in the day.
This can wave on a tall pole.
It will light the dark room.
We eat this little food at school.
<NAME> has a pet with a long ear.
We wipe our mouth with this at lunch.
We pick this round red fruit from a tree.

roots: Four choices only. Exactly one is the real spelling of the short a word the stem clues.
The other three misspell that same word. Never offer a different real word as a wrong choice.
A misspelling may change the vowel, add a silent e, double the a, use ay or ai, drop a letter, or add a consonant.
Every choice is a whole word. Never a single letter, a slash sound, a phoneme, or a held vowel.
Tier 1 targets are three-letter words, and the wrong choices are easy to spot.
Tier 2 targets have a blend or ck. Wrong choices are one edit away, such as snak or lampe.
Tier 3 targets have two syllables. Wrong choices are near misses, such as rabit, aple, or naipkin.
The stem is a kid clue about home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather, and it never contains the target word.

tier_rules.1: Three-letter short a words such as cat and nap. Clues are about four to six words. Wrong choices are obvious: a wrong vowel, an extra a, or a silent e.
tier_rules.2: One-syllable short a words with a blend or ck, such as flag, lamp, and snack. Clues are grade level. Wrong choices change one piece, such as a missing c, an extra a, or a silent e.
tier_rules.3: Two-syllable short a words such as rabbit, napkin, and apple. Clues may use <NAME> and run longer. Wrong choices are near misses: a dropped consonant, ai for a, or an extra letter.

short_a_cvc.en: Short a is the vowel in cat. Spell it with one a.
short_a_cvc.ko: 단모음 a는 cat의 모음입니다. a 한 글자로 쓰세요.

short_a_blend.en: Keep the blend, and spell the vowel with one a.
short_a_blend.ko: 자음군은 그대로 두고 모음은 a 한 글자로 쓰세요.

short_a_ck.en: After a short a, spell k with ck, as in snack.
short_a_ck.ko: 단모음 a 다음의 k는 ck로 씁니다. snack처럼요.

short_a_two.en: In a two-syllable word, short a is still one a, not ai.
short_a_two.ko: 두 음절 단어에서도 단모음 a는 a 한 글자이며 ai가 아닙니다.
